written.headline: US FCC authorizes SpaceX to deploy 1 million Starmind AI satellites
written.summary: The US Federal Communications Commission authorized SpaceX to deploy up to 1 million "Starmind" satellites intended to serve as data centers in space. The approval requires SpaceX to deploy at least one satellite by 2033 and meet the full 1 million satellite milestone by 2040.

written.headline: Microsoft details MAI Base 2 and Rocket training framework
written.summary: Microsoft highlighted its MAI Base 2 model and Rocket reinforcement learning framework for training large models. The company announced seven new MAI models.

written.headline: 42 state attorneys general challenge Character.ai plan to auction private chats
written.summary: A coalition of 42 state AGs is asking a bankruptcy court to block Character.ai’s proposed sale of its platform and private chat data from over 21 million U.S. accounts, including more than 2.1 million minors, scheduled for auction on Dec. 1, 2026.

written.headline: Nadella says Microsoft's MAI models can trail OpenAI by six months if they cost far less to run
written.summary: At the New York Times DealBook Summit on November 18, Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella said the company's in-house MAI models can lag OpenAI and Anthropic by three to six months as long as they use only 5% to 20% of the same compute. Copilot already routes tasks automatically between OpenAI, Anthropic, and Microsoft's own models, with most users leaving selection on Auto.

written.headline: Anthropic migrates Messages API from Python to Rust with Claude agents
written.summary: Anthropic migrated its Messages API from Python to Rust with Claude agents writing and fixing much of the code. The new API uses about 70% less CPU per request and over 80% less memory, and switched public traffic over in September without an outage.
